calls.reasoning: Anchor is the trailing-year spread: NVDA +35.3% vs AAPL +34.6%, i.e. ~0 drift per biweekly period, so the prior median is 0 and the question is almost entirely about dispersion. Small positive tilt to +0.5: NVDA carries post-earnings drift from the Aug 26 beat and $108B Q3 guide, while Apple faces a heavily-leaked Sep 9 event after a run to within 7% of its record, and Apple's post-event fade is a recurring pattern (AAPL fell 3.3% after the 2025 iPhone 17 event). Dispersion dominates: spread SD ~6pp over 9-10 trading days. Evidence is thin on direction and I stay near the base rate. No prediction market prices this contract; the nearest real book (Polymarket year-end largest-company) differs on threshold, deadline and instrument. Escape mass ~2.5-3% each side for an AI-capex scare or melt-up that moves NVDA 15%+ against a near-flat Apple.

calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed on the median (+0.5/+0.6) and disagreed mainly on width (dispersion_90_10 of 14, 14.7, 17.8). I reconciled the underlying vol inputs rather than averaging: Runs 1-2 used option-implied vol (5.6-6.0pp SD), Run 3 used realized/long-run parameters (6.5-7.5pp). Where judgment could not be broken by evidence - Apple event tilt, NVDA drift vs reversal - I took the neutral reading, which is the bet I would make.
